info.name: Soracom and Query Analysis AuditLog API
Retrieve audit logs for Soracom API calls

params.name: api_kind
params.description: Filter item for audit log retrieval by API kind (e.g. `/v1/auth`).

params.name: from_epoch_ms
params.description: Start time for the log search range (unixtime milliseconds).

params.name: to_epoch_ms
params.description: End time for the log search range (unixtime milliseconds).

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of log entries to retrieve (value range is 1 to 1000).

params.name: last_evaluated_key
params.description: The value of `requestedTimeEpochMs` in the last log entry retrieved in the previous page. By specifying this parameter, you can continue to retrieve the list from the next page onward.

items.docs: Retrieve audit logs for Soracom API calls.
